scope: Use exact desktop Bench SOG bytes and authored camera for the demo and empty-viewer tutorial, with distributed Mip-NeRF 360 attribution; retain existing collection/controller/native/history owners.

datasetAttributionReview.method: Observed HTTP HEAD size and bounded HTTP 206 ranges with Python zipfile central-directory parsing; full dataset archives were not downloaded.
datasetAttributionReview.ownerDecision: i think it is a public dataset that can be used here. just mention it in the readme or whereever appropraite
datasetAttributionReview.softwareLicenseDistinction: The MultiNeRF code Apache-2.0 license is not assigned to separately hosted data or this supplied Gaussian model.

commands.initialBrowserResolution: Two pending-fetch cases exposed missing progress/Cancel before lazy example acquisition; corrected in the existing intake owner. The design case counted startup integrity verification as an extra user load; the assertion now distinguishes page action and service-worker ownership.
